drift5_scaled.mechanism: Multi-day displacement may describe unfinished repricing.
drift5_scaled.counterexample: Post-fill returns reverse, or displacement has no incremental information.
drift5_scaled.limitations: A plain momentum control; not a newly independent price-path mechanism.

efficiency5.mechanism: Less reversal for the same displacement may indicate persistent demand.
efficiency5.counterexample: Benefit disappears conditional on five-day return and volatility.
efficiency5.limitations: Strongly related to momentum; endpoint-controlled comparison required.

intraday_efficiency.mechanism: Smooth same-day progress may persist after next-session execution.
intraday_efficiency.counterexample: Information expires before next-day fill or predicts reversal instead.
intraday_efficiency.limitations: Includes between-bar jumps; cannot resolve within-bar paths.

step_persistence.definition: mean(sign(u[:-1])*sign(u[1:])); zero moves have sign zero
step_persistence.mechanism: Persistence versus alternation may distinguish sustained movement from churn.
step_persistence.counterexample: Any apparent effect is explained by endpoint return or variance.
step_persistence.limitations: Directionless persistence; eight steps provide only seven adjacent pairs.

semivariance_balance.mechanism: Unequal upward and downward shocks may identify asymmetric risk.
semivariance_balance.counterexample: Magnitude and direction controls explain the entire relation.
semivariance_balance.limitations: Not net buying; correlated with signed daily displacement.

largest_step_balance.mechanism: The strongest opposing moves may identify fragility or persistence.
largest_step_balance.counterexample: Largest moves are transitory noise with no post-fill information.
largest_step_balance.limitations: Sensitive to one 30-minute interval; no participant interpretation.

post_drop_recovery.definition: After the earliest negative u within absolute 1e-12 log-return of min(u), sum(remaining u)/sum(abs(remaining u)); 0 if no negative step or no remaining movement
post_drop_recovery.mechanism: Response after an adverse move may reveal resilience rather than the drop alone.
post_drop_recovery.counterexample: Recovery merely consumes the future upside before entry.
post_drop_recovery.limitations: Zero also denotes no observed negative shock or no subsequent movement; report these structural cases separately. The fixed 1e-12 tie tolerance makes equivalent log-price steps invariant to floating-point price-unit rounding.

run_length_balance.definition: (longest strictly positive u run-longest strictly negative u run)/8; zeros break runs
run_length_balance.mechanism: Directional duration may differ even when final returns match.
run_length_balance.counterexample: Run effects disappear after controlling endpoint and efficiency.
run_length_balance.limitations: Only nine possible run lengths; correlated with persistence and efficiency.

prior_range_position.mechanism: Relative location may condition remaining reward and risk across the whole range.
prior_range_position.counterexample: Only prior returns explain its apparent usefulness.
prior_range_position.limitations: Continuous all-day location, not a breakout event; bounded compression discards absolute range size.

close_location.mechanism: Retention of the day range may describe acceptance or late rejection.
close_location.counterexample: Current-day strength does not survive the next-session execution delay.
close_location.limitations: No ordering of daily high and low is inferred; familiar range-position expression.

open_side_occupation.mechanism: Time spent above versus below the opening reference may add information beyond final close.
open_side_occupation.counterexample: Occupation has no value after conditioning on open-to-close return.
open_side_occupation.limitations: Eight equally weighted snapshots, not exact time occupancy or traded volume.

wick_rejection.mechanism: Asymmetric return from bar extremes may indicate failure to sustain one direction.
wick_rejection.counterexample: Wicks reflect ordinary volatility and contain no incremental forward information.
wick_rejection.limitations: No within-bar high-low order; raw OHLC does not prove rejection by an identified participant.

range_expansion.mechanism: A sudden change in activity may forecast future risk or available space.
range_expansion.counterexample: Range expansion forecasts only already-realized movement.
range_expansion.limitations: Unsigned risk descriptor; positive expected return is not assumed.

prior_range_compression.definition: (mean(TR previous5)-mean(TR previous20))/(mean(TR previous5)+mean(TR previous20)); excludes current day
prior_range_compression.mechanism: Recent compression or expansion may condition future movement size.
prior_range_compression.counterexample: Compression has no incremental size information versus baseline volatility.
prior_range_compression.limitations: Does not assign a direction; related to rolling volatility states.

shock_concentration.definition: max(u^2)/sum(u^2); 0 when every observed step is zero
shock_concentration.mechanism: One-shock movement may differ from movement distributed over the session.
shock_concentration.counterexample: Concentration effects are explained by magnitude or gap exposure.
shock_concentration.limitations: Range [1/8,1] for non-flat days; flat-day 0 is a distinct observed state.

gap_energy_share.definition: g^2/(g^2+sum(u^2)); g=log(adjusted day Open/previous adjusted Close)
gap_energy_share.mechanism: Overnight-dominated movement may leave different executable daytime opportunity.
gap_energy_share.counterexample: All information is realized before the allowed order can execute.
gap_energy_share.limitations: Gap is adjusted, intraday is raw dimensionless; one historical price snapshot does not certify historical publication time.

return_time_balance.mechanism: Timing of signed movement may distinguish early adjustment from ongoing repricing.
return_time_balance.counterexample: Time weighting is redundant with endpoint return or half-day contrast.
return_time_balance.limitations: Linear full-session weighting; not a tail-only rule; no intraday trading authorization.

extrema_order.definition: (earliest argmax(bar High)-earliest argmin(bar Low))/7; 0 when same bar
extrema_order.mechanism: Low-before-high and high-before-low paths may imply different residual movement.
extrema_order.counterexample: Order supplies no information after endpoint and volatility controls.
extrema_order.limitations: Same-bar order is unknown and encoded zero, not asserted simultaneous; ties choose earliest observed bar.

excursion_balance.definition: (maximum subsequent rise-maximum subsequent fall)/sum(abs(u)) on log path [day Open,eight closes]
excursion_balance.mechanism: Observed drawup versus drawdown may distinguish path resilience.
excursion_balance.counterexample: Excursion balance only restates terminal return or fails on future held-position outcomes.
excursion_balance.limitations: Close-sampled path misses within-bar extremes; entry labels cannot validate a holding/exit rule.

halfday_balance.mechanism: Morning and afternoon contribution may differ in persistence to executable next day.
halfday_balance.counterexample: Difference vanishes at actual fill or is redundant with return_time_balance.
halfday_balance.limitations: Four bars per half; u[4] includes the transition from morning close to first afternoon close.

direction_alignment.mechanism: Daily and intraday directional agreement may condition continuation or exhaustion.
direction_alignment.counterexample: Interaction adds nothing beyond its two constituent signals.
direction_alignment.limitations: Derived interaction, explicitly not a third independent information source; symmetric in simultaneous sign reversal.

drift_acceleration.mechanism: Recent drift relative to the preceding background may identify a changing adjustment process.
drift_acceleration.counterexample: Acceleration is only another representation of ordinary momentum.
drift_acceleration.limitations: Overlapping observations across days; baseline return controls and chronology required.

intraday_daily_energy.mechanism: Current intraday movement energy relative to daily background may forecast risk regime changes.
intraday_daily_energy.counterexample: Scale difference is mechanical or adds nothing beyond range expansion.
intraday_daily_energy.limitations: Different return sampling scales; daily mean-square includes gaps and drift, not a formal variance decomposition.

nested_range_ratio.mechanism: Current daily excursion compared with broader space may reveal scale expansion.
nested_range_ratio.counterexample: Nested-range information is redundant with TR expansion or range position.
nested_range_ratio.limitations: Unsigned adjusted-price range comparison; does not infer breakout or profitable direction.

purpose: 普查时不查看新特征与收益关系；先固定表达，不挑选赢者。
